title: Add slugify to textutil
requirement: We need URL slugs for article titles. Add a function slugify(text, max_length=60) to textutil/strings.py: lower-case, ASCII only (strip accents, so 'Crème brûlée' becomes 'creme-brulee'), every run of characters that are not letters or digits becomes a single hyphen, no hyphen at either end, and the result is cut to max_length without leaving a trailing hyphen. Export it from textutil/__init__.py like the other helpers, and add tests.
acceptance: never longer than max_length and never ends in a hyphen
